items.rationale: The shop measured 41,200 ÷ 52,000 mWh = 79.2%, below the 80% cutoff in §2.6.8, and no battery-health waiver applies. Sections 2.6.7 and 5.2.3 therefore exclude the diagnostic even though it established the exclusion; €65 is a conditional estimate below the €250 gross cap.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The impact is consistent with §§2.6.1–2.6.3, but the measured battery capacity of 79.2% excludes the entire unit under §§2.6.8 and 2.6.7, not just the battery. The conditional estimate uses the pictured €549 parts-and-labour quote for both damaged areas.
